**Bugs I noticed:**

1. **The first try failed.** On my first send the agent returned `{"error": "Internal error. Please try again."}` with no `reply` field. The reply above came from a second send of the same message. That means the agent got the message twice, which could matter if it keeps conversation state.
2. **Errors come back as HTTP 200.** On the retry the status was `200 OK`. I didn't capture the status code on the failed call, so I can't say for sure that the error was also sent as a 200. If it was, clients can't tell success from failure by status code.
3. **It may have guessed which order.** "The mug thing again" is vague, but the agent answered with specific order details and didn't say which order or item it meant. Nothing in the reply mentions a mug, so I can't tell if it found the right order or made one up.
4. **The deadline is vague.** "By Friday" doesn't say which Friday. Today is Sunday 2026-10-04, so it's unclear whether that means 2026-10-09 or a later one.
5. **Small formatting slip.** The heading `## Order status` ends with two trailing spaces, which in Markdown makes a hard line break. The other lines use plain newlines, so in many Markdown renderers "Shipped", "Courier" and "Tracking" would run together on one line.
